# Purple Canary

> Forensic thin-layer and paper chromatography analysis suite for harm reduction: identify adulterants, cuts, and poisons in substances with computer-vision chromatography. "Spot → Snap → Know."

## Forensic Suite

- [Purple Canary Analysis Suite](https://purplecanarylab.com/): PURPLE CANARY FORENSIC SUITE vβ — phone app plus custom hardware (calibrated TLC strips, dual-band 365/395nm UV light, D-limonene solvent, reagent, vacuum micro-boiler) using computer-vision chromatography.

## Coverage

- [Purple Canary](https://purplecanarylab.com/): 285+ substances with instant risk ratings (CLEAN / HIGH RISK / LETHAL); live network feed includes MDMA, cocaine, ketamine, LSD, THC, amphetamine, and fentanyl.

## Pricing

- [Purple Canary](https://purplecanarylab.com/): Hardware kit $25.00; approximately 0.167¢ per test.

## Disclaimers

- [Purple Canary](https://purplecanarylab.com/): For educational and harm-reduction purposes only. Presumptive use — not a replacement for GC-MS lab testing.
